name: Browse Modes
description: Adds trending and top rated discover lists, narrowed to the items your library already has. Backs the Browse Modes tile grid in the web and Android TV clients.
overview: Discover lists for the Browse Modes tile grid.

versions.changelog: No functional change to the plugin. Rebuilt so every artifact in the release shares a version, and the assembly version now comes from the release tag.
First release. Adds /Discover/{Trending,TopRated}/{Movies,Shows} and a scheduled task that keeps the TMDb lists warm.
